description: This file defines the TermBreadcrumbBuilder class, which implements breadcrumb navigation for taxonomy terms in Drupal, using the term hierarchy to generate breadcrumbs.

classes.name: TermBreadcrumbBuilder
classes.description: A custom breadcrumb builder for taxonomy terms that constructs breadcrumbs based on the term hierarchy.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the entity type manager and repository dependencies.

methods.name: applies
methods.description: Determines if the breadcrumb builder applies to the current route, specifically for taxonomy term pages.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the breadcrumb trail for a taxonomy term page, including parent terms.
